settings.title: Settings
settings.fileTimeoutHint: Range 30–3600 seconds, default 600. After a timeout the file is marked as failed; increase this value and retry.
settings.hotkeyHint: Example: Ctrl+Alt+Q. Supports main keys such as A-Z, 0-9 and F1-F12. Takes effect immediately.
settings.ocrHint: Select at least one. The Chinese engine also handles mixed Chinese and English. Install the corresponding Optical Character Recognition feature in Windows Settings first.
settings.translationHint: The language list comes from the server's /languages endpoint; click Test connection to refresh it.
settings.fontHint: Applies to the recognized text and translation areas.
settings.autoStart: Start with Windows (run automatically after sign-in)
settings.autoStartHint: The startup entry is written to the current user registry and can be seen under Startup in Task Manager.
settings.serverHint: Tip: the default server URL is http://192.168.3.5:5000. LibreTranslate must load the en and zh models; you can also run docker compose up -d in the project root to start a local service.
settings.testSuccess: Connected. Loaded {0} languages (including Chinese and English).
settings.testMissingModels: Connected, but the service is missing the Chinese or English model. Check the LT_LOAD_ONLY configuration.
settings.testNoLanguages: Connected, but the service did not return a language list.
settings.invalidFontSize: Font size must be a number between 8 and 72
settings.invalidTimeout: File translation timeout must be an integer between 30 and 3600 seconds
settings.ocrRequired: Select at least one OCR language
settings.invalidServerUrl: The server URL must be a full address starting with http:// or https://
settings.sameLanguage: Source and target languages cannot be the same (unless the source is Auto detect)
